calculation.description: For each tradable benchmark instrument, compute the negative completed-session return divided by trailing 10-session realized return volatility, then average the resulting signal over the latest three completed sessions. Higher values indicate stronger risk-adjusted short-term reversal.

validation.interpretation: Passes the benchmark daily IC and ICIR gates. Smoothing reduces the turnover proxy versus the unsmoothed variant (0.2039 versus 0.3386), while positive daily IC persists across all evaluated regimes. Longer-horizon decay is weak, so use as a short-horizon ensemble sleeve and audit correlation before assigning material weight.
